entries.1abd4a059a9ec9e3: Tabio Corporation has four consolidated subsidiaries and one non-consolidated subsidiary, and its consolidated number of employees as of February 28, 2026 was 268. entries.c4d7199ce91dd6e8: As its vision, it states "We will realize the world's foremost comprehensive sock company" and says it will deliver the excellence of Made in Japan socks to Japan and the world. As issues to address, it cites boosting customer numbers by expanding entry-price-range products (the full-scale rollout of the "3 pairs for ¥1,100 (tax included)" zone and the launch of the new line "Kutsushitaya fam"), promoting DX through a full renewal of its own EC site and strengthening of malls, and strengthening the baseball division in the sports field and developing new sales channels in the BtoB area.
entries.cd3084c9e047de03: A single segment that plans and sells socks, pantyhose and tights. It consists of the company, 4 consolidated subsidiaries (Tabio Nara Co., Ltd., Tabio France S.A.S., Tabio Retail S.A.S. and Tabiou Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.) and 1 non-consolidated subsidiary (Tabio Factory Co., Ltd.). Tabio Nara Co., Ltd. handles logistics from product storage through shipment, as well as product research, inspection and quality control. As of February 28, 2026, the number of stores was 266 in total, consisting of 154 directly operated stores and 112 franchise chain stores. Revenue in the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥16,812 million.
